title: ChainChama
tagline: We want to allow small businesses to save and access short term liquidity at more affordable rates while adhering to peer to peer , open protocol principles and tailoring it to serve African consumer behaviour
description:
Chama cha crypto ~ savings and lending in the context of the digital economy consumers from the global south.

Technicals of Idea 

Smart Contracts
Chama Contract: Solidity smart contract to handle Chama creation, membership, roles, governance, and financial transactions.
Membership Management: Functions to add/remove members, manage roles.
Governance and Voting: Functions to propose and vote on decisions, and execute outcomes.
Fund Management: Functions to handle contributions, fund allocation, and withdrawals.

Data Storage
Blockchain Storage: Use the Ethereum blockchain for recording transactions and governance decisions.

Integration with External Services
Authentication: Integration with World ID for secure user verification or Unlock.
Banking APIs: (If applicable) Integration for off-chain fiat transactions, if your Chama involves interaction with traditional banking systems.
how_its_made: Using mostly Typescript/Javascript heavy tech integrations, simple UI and UX philosophies and a deep understanding of the problems of Fintech as well as Small to Medium-sized businesses in Kenya, we aim to use open protocols to create a tool that helps facilitate lending and small community savings while still accommodating current common user interactive flows.
